messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["eagle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large bird of prey standing in profile facing right, with an eagle-like head, hooked beak and fierce eye, a robust feather-covered body in shades of brown with a paler belly, folded wings along its sides showing dark flight feathers beneath fluffy coverts, two thick feathered legs ending in scaly yellow feet with long black talons, and a long broad feathered tail extending behind.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "feathered eagle-like head with brown plumage and a small crest on the crown", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "sharply hooked raptor beak yellow at the base and dark gray at the tip", "part": "beak", "where": "on the front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "yellow-brown raptor eye with a fierce brow", "part": "eye", "where": "on the side of the head above the beak"}, {"looks_like": "layered pointed brown feathers darker on the neck and lighter on the chest", "part": "neck and chest feathers", "where": "covering the neck and upper front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "dense fluffy brown feathers on the back and sides with whitish-tan feathers on the lower belly", "part": "body plumage", "where": "covering the torso from neck to tail base"}, {"looks_like": "folded wings with fluffy brown coverts and dark brown flight feathers underneath", "part": "wings", "where": "along both sides of the body"}, {"looks_like": "thick brown feathered legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the belly extending down to the feet"}, {"looks_like": "scaly yellow raptor feet with long curved black talons", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long broad brown feathered tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body extending down and to the left"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
